name: DPG-Bench
intro: DPG-Bench（Dense Prompt Graph Benchmark）由ELLA论文提出，用于评估文生图模型对长且信息密集提示的语义遵循能力。它包含1,065个由四类来源扩写、人工核验并以DSG问题图标注的提示；模型每题生成4张图，由mPLUG-large回答语义问题并按DSG图规则评分。
build_method: 四源数据聚合, GPT-4密集扩写, 人工核验, DSG问题图标注
metric: DPG-Bench Graph Score, Global, Entity, Attribute, Relation, Other
task_type: 图像生成, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 细粒度问题图评测, 多图生成, MLLM裁判
scale: 1,065个提示, 平均83.91个CLIP词元, 5个一级类别, 13个二级类别
build_method_en: Four-source aggregation, GPT-4 dense expansion, human verification, DSG question-graph annotation
eval_feature_en: Fine-grained question-graph evaluation, multi-image generation, MLLM judge
intro_en: DPG-Bench (Dense Prompt Graph Benchmark) was introduced in the ELLA paper to evaluate semantic following of long, information-dense prompts by text-to-image models. Its 1,065 prompts are expanded from four sources, human-verified, and annotated with DSG question graphs; models generate four images per prompt, mPLUG-large answers semantic questions, and DSG graph rules determine the score.
scale_en: 1,065 prompts, mean 83.91 CLIP tokens, 5 level-1 and 13 level-2 categories
metric_en: DPG-Bench Graph Score, Global, Entity, Attribute, Relation, Other
drawio_review_note: Aligned with ELLA arXiv:2403.05135 Section 4 and the official TencentQQGYLab/ELLA evaluation release. The diagram records COCO, PartiPrompts, DSG-1k, and Object365 sources; expansion of the first three and sampling 1-4 Object365 objects; GPT-4 scene/attribute/relation enrichment; human verification; a second GPT-4 DSG pass for tuple categories, questions, and dependency graphs; the exact 1,065-prompt, 83.91-token, 4,286-noun, 5/13-category benchmark; four generated images per prompt; mPLUG-large question answering; DSG graph scoring; and the overall plus Global/Entity/Attribute/Relation/Other reports.
